Package hadur.bench

Class MeleeHarvester

java.lang.Object
robocode.control.events.BattleAdaptor
hadur.bench.MeleeHarvester
All Implemented Interfaces:
robocode.control.events.IBattleListener
public class MeleeHarvester extends robocode.control.events.BattleAdaptor
Watches a melee battle from the outside, for the melee gates.
  • hadur.log: every line Hadur printed, as round,turn,line.
  • rounds.csv: one row per round (HEADER): Hadur's finishing place among the non-sentry robots, who was left when the field thinned to Hadur and one other (the duel the melee handed over to) and whether Hadur won it, sentry bullets that hit Hadur and Hadur bullets that hit a sentry, and skipped turns.
